name: agent-coord
description: Review and organize work threads across workspaces, and coordinate local Codex and Claude Code sessions through write-conflict detection, durable messages, and delegation.

interface.shortDescription: Manage threads and coordinate coding agents.
interface.longDescription: Review open work across workspaces with Thread Manager, organize threads into projects and Now/Later/Closed, preserve progress checkpoints, coordinate concurrent write scopes, exchange durable messages, and delegate scoped work to Codex or Claude Code workers. Beads is optional.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $manage-threads to review my open threads across all workspaces, summarize what needs attention, and help me organize them.
